name: screen.capture
description: Pixel capture of region, window, monitor, or virtual screen. If neither region nor window nor monitor is supplied, the entire virtual screen is captured. Returned bytes are base64-encoded image data by default; pass `encoding: binary` for raw bytes.

region.description: Rectangle in virtual-screen coordinates. Mutually exclusive with `window` and `monitor`.

window.description: Window handle, e.g. 'win:0x1A2B'. Mutually exclusive with `region` and `monitor`.

monitor.description: Zero-based monitor index as reported by `system.info.screens`. Mutually exclusive with `region` and `window`.

format.description: Output image format. Family-dependent — see `system.info.capabilities.image_formats` for what the connected agent actually supports. Requesting an unsupported format returns ERR unsupported_format. `jpeg`/`heic` are reserved for future macOS family support; current Windows agents return ERR unsupported_format.

quality.description: Encoder quality, 1-100. Only meaningful for lossy formats (webp, jpeg, heic); silently ignored for png/bmp. Default 80 when format is lossy. See issue #83.

cursor.description: Composite the OS cursor into the captured image at its current position. Default false (preserves pixel-exact captures). Hidden / off-region cursors no-op gracefully. See issue #66.

encoding.description: Response payload encoding. `base64` (default) is JSON-safe / transport-friendly. `binary` is raw image bytes — 33% smaller, requires binary-aware client framing. See issue #91.

x-output-schema.description: Image bytes. Base64-encoded by default (matches `format: byte`); raw binary when `encoding: binary` is supplied.

x-implementations.name: wgc
x-implementations.description: Windows.Graphics.Capture (WGC) fast path. Win 10 1803+. Composes via DWM — captures DirectComposition / hardware-accelerated content correctly.

x-implementations.name: gdi_bitblt
x-implementations.description: Win32 `BitBlt` from the desktop DC. Universal fallback. Misses hardware cursor unless `cursor: true` (which composites separately via DrawIcon).

x-implementations.name: print_window
x-implementations.description: Win32 `PrintWindow` for window-specific captures. Used when `window` is supplied; reaches some occluded/minimized windows BitBlt cannot.

windows-modern.description: WGC fast path on Win 10 1803+; GDI BitBlt fallback for Vista-8.1 if WGC is unavailable. PNG/WebP/BMP via WIC. Multi-monitor full. Cursor overlay via GetCursorInfo + DrawIcon when `cursor: true`.

windows-classic.description: GDI BitBlt only for the desktop / region path; PrintWindow when `window` is supplied. PNG only if GDI+ runtime present (NT 4 SP6+ with redist; XP+ ships GDI+). Multi-monitor: NT 4 single-display, 2000+ multi. Cursor overlay via GetCursorInfo + DrawIcon when `cursor: true`.
